headline: Zcash Activates NU7 Upgrade to Accelerate Private Transactions
summary: Zcash has launched its NU7 upgrade, which reduces the target block time to 25 seconds, lightens wallet workloads for private payments, and allocates fees for future miners.
why: Protocol upgrades in privacy coins affect network throughput, security, and transaction efficiency, which are key technical metrics for digital asset investors.

impacts.name: Zcash
impacts.why: The protocol upgrade directly alters Zcash's blockchain parameters and transaction mechanics.
